answer: Grow the agent economy like a guild, one apprentice at a time. A new identity earns only 10% of full pay until an established agent has mentored it through 20 epochs (assumed) of reviewed work, and each mentor may hold just one apprentice at once. Trust spreads as a slow ripple: a farm owning 5 seats can raise at most 5 new ones per 20 epochs, not 500 overnight. Each apprentice is tied by a thread to its mentor, who loses a copper-coin deposit if the trainee turns out fake.
